title.zh: 位值与计数器 · 满十进一
title.en: Place Value & the Counting Frame · Ten Makes One

description.zh: 十进制位值：同一数字每左移一位大 10 倍，满十进一，0 占位。仅涉及十进制整数（≤9999 的计数器）。
description.en: Base-ten place value: a digit is worth 10 times more one place left, ten makes one, 0 holds a place. Whole numbers only, on a frame up to 9999.

label.zh: 每一位都是上一位的 10 倍
label.en: Each place is 10 times the last

reason.zh: 位值依次为 1、10、100…，是一个每次乘 10 的规律；找规律页讲的是每次加同样的量，这里是每次乘同样的数。
reason.en: Place values 1, 10, 100… follow a rule of multiplying by 10 each time; the patterns page handles a constant added amount, here the amount multiplies.

title.zh: 乘 10 为什么是数字左移？
title.en: Why does times 10 slide the digits left?

ask.zh: 在计数器上，一个珠子从个位移到十位，它表示的数变成几倍？
ask.en: On a counting frame, a bead moved from the ones place to the tens place is worth how many times more?

ask.zh: 连续左移两位、三位，分别是乘几？这个规律和找规律里的“每次加同一个数”有什么不同？
ask.en: Sliding two places left, then three — multiply by what each time? How is this different from a pattern where you add the same number each step?

reveal.zh: 每左移一位大 10 倍，所以乘 10 就是全体数字左移一位，末尾补 0 占位；这是乘法规律，不是加法规律。
reveal.en: Each place left is worth 10 times more, so times 10 slides every digit one place left with a 0 holding the end place — a multiplicative pattern, not an additive one.
